prompts.home: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-end studio rendering of TWO full Android smartphones side by side, straight-on, identical black slim realistic devices, equal size, fully visible including bottom edges, on a solid very dark evergreen #0a1c16 background. Landscape 3:2 composition, phones tall and large, each centered in its own half with generous separation. This is an AppShield fictional before/after critique for a HABIT AND DAILY PLANNING APP called Dayform, not hiking. LEFT phone A: plausible but very generic AI-built habit tracker: purple-to-blue gradient header 'Dayform', greeting 'Hey Alex! 👋', headline 'Crush your goals! 🚀', four rounded pastel stat cards with oversized generic emojis flame/trophy/target/star and labels 'Streak', 'Goals', 'Points', 'Level'. A vague white habit list 'Drink water 💧', 'Read a book 📚', 'Exercise 💪' with equal-looking buttons. At very bottom of its screen an oversized recognizable green Android robot logo is awkwardly placed ON TOP of the bottom navigation and purple 'Add habit' button, visibly obstructing a useful control; show home/stats/profile emoji icons. This is an intentional UI flaw to critique. RIGHT phone B: genuinely outstanding distinctive premium editorial habit app, SAME app Dayform redesigned with an understated custom geometric wordmark, warm ivory canvas, deep ink text, rich forest green and a tiny burnt-orange accent. Elegant display headline 'Make room for\nwhat matters.' Spacious sophisticated typography, precise aligned hierarchy. Small upper row 'MONDAY, SEPT 7' and profile avatar. One large deep evergreen focus panel 'YOUR NEXT SMALL WIN' / 'Read for 20 minutes' / elegant outlined book icon / a highly legible ivory 'Begin focus' action. Below, 'Your rhythm' with beautiful minimal seven-day vertical bar chart (restrained olive bars and one orange highlight), caption '4 of 7 days this week'. Then two tidy rows 'Drink water' with real progress 3 / 8 glasses and 'Evening walk' with time 6:00 PM. Refined custom thin-line bottom nav with labels Today, Rhythm, You. Comfortable Android gesture safe area at bottom, NO Android mascot on B. No emojis anywhere on B. Right must look dramatically more crafted and purposeful, an actual premium app ready to use, not a generic card dashboard. Crisp legible text. Photorealistic hardware with matte glass and soft studio shadows; SCREEN CONTENT FLAT AND SHARP, no perspective warp or reflections obscuring UI. No text or labels outside phones, no A/B lettering outside, no extra objects, no watermark. Both phones complete, same height.
